text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, May 13 - Chittagong - 24 Vessels in port of which 3 containers, 3 general cargo, 4 food grain, 1 cement clinker, 4 cement, 2 tankers. 5 Under repair, 2 scraping. 26 Vessels due by 20/5 of which 12 containers, 9 general cargo, 1 grain, 1 car carrier, 3 tankers. No berthing delays.

INDIA, May 13 - Bombay - Labour gang shortage due to holidays and vacation. Seven vessels loading at berth, 21 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage. 3 Waiting at anchorage to load, 12 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 under repair, 3 awaiting orders. Delays expected, containers/general cargo vessels 1-2 days, bulkers 4-5 days. Calcutta - Seven vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 1 bunkering. 25 Vessels due (3 coal, 8 products tankers, 5 containers, 1 general cargo, 1 crude oil, 2 coal, 1 logs, 1 petcoke, 1 pulses).

Cochin - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 1 under repair, 1 naval vessel dry-docked, 8 due with 1-2 days delay expected. Chennai (Madras) - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchor to load, 2 waiting at anchor to discharge. 30 Vessels due (4 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 fertiliser, 7 general cargo, 11 containers, 1 sunflower seed oil, 1 sko, 1 panamax, 3 other vessels), with the following delays expected, scrap 4-5 days, iron ore 5-6 days, coal/coke/fertiliser/others 2-3 days, no delays for containers.

Mormugao - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 8 loading at anchorage, 3 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage. 13 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. 11 Vessels due (8 ore, 1 containers, 1 petroleum, 1 panamax) with the following delays, ore 4-5 days, no delays for containers/petroleum/panamax. Kandla - Four vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 10 waiting to load, 6 anchored waiting to discharge, 2 under arrest in inner harbour, 3 tankers. 11 Vessels waiting, 17 due with 7-8 days delay expected.

Mangalore - No labour problems. Seven vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 awaiting berths, 1 under arrest. 7 Vessels due with 2-3 days delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. Three vessels discharging at berth (2 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain, 1 tanker/iron ore). 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (3 tankers/iron ore, 2 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain). 5 Vessels due (3 food grain/fertiliser, 2 tankers/iron ore) with following delays, food grain/fertiliser 20 days, tankers/iron ore 10 days.

Paradip - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 5 waiting at anchorage to load. 9 Vessels due with 10 days delay expected. Tuticorin - No labour problems. Six vessels discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 2 loading at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 due with 1-2 days delay expected at present. Visakhapatnam - Six vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 12 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth. 16 Vessels due with 7-8 days delay expected.

MALAYSIA, May 14 - Port Klang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 9 Vessels berthed, 8 waiting with no delays. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Vessels berthed, 5 waiting with 2 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 3 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 4 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 3 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 2 days waiting time. West port container/ro-ro berth - 3 Vessels berthed, 1 waiting with no delays. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 6 waiting with 3 days waiting time. Cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, none waiting, no delays. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays.

PAKISTAN, May 12 - Karachi - Four vessels loading at berth (rice, clinker, mol), 4 container vessels loading/discharging at berth. 12 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, sugar, phosphates, palm oil, hsd). 2 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, fuel oil, general cargo), 2 vessels awaiting orders. 7 Vessels due with following delays expected, general cargo/containers 1-2 days, rice loaders 8 days. Port Qasim - Six vessels discharging at berth (palm oil, project cargo, wheat, iron ore). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (project cargo, sugar), 1 waiting at anchorage to load crude oil.

PHILIPPINES, May 13 - Manila - South harbour - 7 Vessels discharging at berth, 9 discharging at anchorage, 2 waiting at outer anchorage to discharge, 3 taking on water. Average waiting times, no delays for vessels with draft less than 8 metres and loa less than 130 metres, 1-2 days delay for vessels with draft greater than 9 metres and loa greater than 140 metres.

SIERRA LEONE, May 12 - Freetown - No labour problems. One rice discharger berthed, 5 vessels due of which 1 tanker to discharge refined products, 2 aid cargo dischargers, 1 wheat discharger, 1 container discharger/loader. No delays expected.

SINGAPORE, May 13 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 10 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 13 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 10 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 2 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 6 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 21 Tankers berthed, minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys.

SOUTH KOREA, May 13 - Inchon - 64 Vessels in port (44 berthed, 20 anchored) of which berthed, 10 logs, 6 general cargo, 4 steel, 4 containers, 3 corn, 1 pig-iron, 1 red beans, 1 lupins, 1 wheat blending pellets, 1 stone, 1 ply-wood, 1 molasses, 1 copper, 1 raw sugar, 1 coils, 1 bananas, 1 pulp, 1 cars, 1 timber, 1 tapioca, 1 wheat, 1 scrap. Vessels anchored, 4 general cargo, 2 corn, 2 coils, 2 containers, 2 pulp, 1 raw sugar, 1 palm oil, 1 coke, 1 logs, 1 soya beans, 1 steel billets, 1 silica sand, 1 wheat. Approx. 1-2 days berthing delay expected at present.

Busan - 163 Vessels in port (48 berthed, 115 anchored including 58 laid-up) of which berthed, 33 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 57 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 2 days delay expected. Pohang - 22 Vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 2 zinc concentrates, 1 coal, 1 soda ash, 1 logs, 1 methanol, 1 feed meal, 1 caustic soda, 1 mono ethyl glycol, 1 wood-chips, 1 sugar, 1 chemical, 1 copper concentrates, 1 selestaite, 1 corn, 1 styrene monomer, 1 propane. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 1 pipes, 1 chemicals, no berthing delays expected.

Ulsan - 30 Vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 3 mono-ethyl glycol, 2 mixed xylene, 2 wood-chips, 2 zinc concentrates, 2 copper ncentrates, 1 coal, 1 feed meal, 1 coke, 1 salt, 1 cement, 1 styrene monomer, 1 rock phosphate, 1 corn, 1 naphtha, 1 fuel oil, 1 crude oil. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 1 fertiliser, 1 pipes, 1 resin, 1 mixed xylene, 1 kerosene, no berthing delays. Masan - Eight vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 3 scrap, 1 pig iron, 1 tapioca. Vessels loading, 1 steel plates, 1 cars, 1 cigarettes, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, May 13 - No labour problems. Inter-monsoonal rains. Colombo - 17 Vessels loading at berth (12 containers, 3 essential services, 1 general cargo, 1 tea on pallets). 22 Discharging at berth (10 containers, 1 bagged fertiliser, 1 bagged rice, 4 general cargo, 4 bagged sugar, 1 lpg, 1 bagged onions). 7 Container vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 14 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (7 containers, 1 bagged flour, 1 timber/steel, 2 bagged sugar, 1 steel, 1 bagged cement, 1 urea/cement). 1 Vessel bunkering, 2 under repairs, 5 dry-docked. 7 Vessels due of which 4 containers, 1 bagged fertiliser, 2 ro-ros. Berthing delays, containers 1-2 days, conventional vessels 1 week. Galle - Two vessels discharging at berth. Trincomalee - Three vessels loading at berth.

TAIWAN, May 12 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 5 days, steel/iron ore 3 days, no delays for grain. Kaohsiung - five vessels anchored, berthing delays - grain/steel - 2 days, iron/coal - 4 days (csc berth), coal/scrap - 2 days (public berth). Taichung - Seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel 1 day, grain 6-7 days, others 1-2 days.
